opening.argument: The speaker presents the Wells Fargo Cash Wise card’s $200 signup bonus with its condition plainly stated: spend $1,000 within the first three months. That offer is accompanied by a meaningful warning, not an assurance of risk-free money. The speaker says credit-card use can lead to excessive spending and advises people who have recently carried a balance not to get the card at all. The Plastiq referral is described separately from the card application, with its own spending condition for fee-free payments. Nothing in the cited material shows a hidden credential request, payment capture screen, guaranteed investment scheme, or impersonation claim.

citations.quote: You get $200 signup bonus after you spend $1,000. Within the first three months.
This is a very real problem so if you do not have at least a year or two of not carrying. A balance I would not recommend to get this credit card at all.
